headline: Olavis Wake Front Breaks Open as Weathered Expanse Bloodbath Continues
war_summary: Olavis Wake has dramatically broken its stalemate over the past three hours, logging four base turnovers amid fierce fighting across Iltaku, Kulkue, and Koskinla as casualty rates surged. Meanwhile, Weathered Expanse remains the war's most violent cauldron, recording six fresh base exchanges in the last two hours alone and more than thirteen hundred casualties as Spirit Watch and Frostmarch change hands repeatedly. To the west, the earlier eruptions in Kuura Strand and Nevish Line have paused their base swaps over the past two hours, though Kuura Strand retains an even territorial split under continuing pressure. Contested clashes also persisted along the central ridges, with Linn of Mercy and Marban Hollow each registering two fresh base transitions—centered on the scarred grounds of Outwich Ranch and Checkpoint Bua—while Pari Peak posted another pair of turnovers. Elsewhere, immense casualty spikes shook Callahan’s Passage, Dead Lands, and Farranac Coast, yet fortifications in those sectors held firm without strategic ground changing hands.
